snippet.text: `def ns (U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := -2 * partialY U p` — the chain's middle member n_s = -2U_X, with `partialY F p = deriv (fun Y => F (Y, p.2)) p.1` differentiating in the first slot, which here carries the original radius X (the Lean fields are evaluated at `(X, η)` under `Λ * X ≤ 41/10`)
